responsibility: Selects and dispatches work packages, obtains acceptance under the configured policy, and persists workflow state and acceptance records for the workspace adapter to verify.
owns: Task selection and dispatch, acceptance capture, and the content of state.json and acceptance records.
boundary: Cannot declare validity, readiness or qualification independently of the required checks.
A tool recommendation is never recorded as acceptance; acceptance names its authorized decision maker or delegated policy.

provides.name: acceptanceRecords
provides.concurrency: One record per accepted subject; trusted only once present at the trusted ref or signed by a listed key.

provides.name: workflowState
provides.concurrency: Transient execution state; never an authority for a decision or for acceptance.
